title: The editor's car, leaving
logline: The alley from the garage door: a small clean car with Washington plates pulling out, and this time the strip's Wood is in the doorway watching it go. From behind. The tote bag on her passenger seat, full.

panels.composition: From inside the garage's open door: a small clean car with Washington plates backing out of the alley, a tote bag on its passenger seat stuffed with folders, and in the doorway from behind, a man in plaid and a small dog watching it go. Rain beginning.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, seen from inside an open garage door, a small clean car with Washington plates backing out of an alley with a stuffed tote bag on its passenger seat, a man in plaid flannel and a small three-legged dog in the doorway watching from behind, rain beginning, no words
image.notes: Washington plates again (2018). This time he's in the doorway.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Washington plates, and he's there this time.
